approvals_item_10.step_1_result: the containment assertions pass with no slack at all, so they were left at zero - stricter than they were
approvals_item_10.why: the overlap judgement could not go to zero. Measured with a temporary probe: the window sits exactly inside its own tile, and the neighbouring tile's own box overruns that edge by 0.015625px - the mosaic lays tiles out at fractional widths, so the seam itself overlaps. A judgement of 'any overlap at all' is a judgement about that rounding
approvals_item_10.what: the overlap is judged by amount now - the smaller of the two axis overlaps must not exceed 1px. A real encroachment is the cascade step (28px) or the inflated minimum (tens of px)
approvals_item_10.note: the Rnd-minimum mutant is killed earlier, by the size assertion and the exact containment. The overlap check is a backstop against a layout in which tiles genuinely overlap, which no window-side mutant can produce
